en.s: The English invasion of France of 1230 was a military campaign undertaken by Henry III of England in an attempt to reclaim his family rights and inheritance to the territories of France, held prior to 1224. The English army did not seek battle with the French, did not invade the Duchy of Normandy and marched south to the County of Poitou.

en.s: The siege of Pskov between 9 August and 27 October 1615 was the final battle of the Ingrian War with which the hostilities ended. Swedish forces under Gustav II Adolf laid siege to Pskov, but were unable to take the city.

en.s: The Naval battle of Saint-Martin-de-Ré (French:Bataille navale de Saint-Martin-de-Ré) took place on 27 October 1622, between the Huguenot fleet of La Rochelle under Jean Guiton, and a Royal fleet under Charles de Guise. Under Henry IV the city had enjoyed a certain freedom and prosperity until the 1620s, but the city entered in conflict with the central authority of King Louis XIII with the Huguenot rebellion of 1622.

zh.s: 圣马丁德雷海战（法语：Bataille navale de Saint-Martin-de-Ré）于1622年10月27日发生，交战双方为让·吉东指挥的拉罗谢尔胡格诺派舰队，以及夏尔·德·吉斯指挥的王家舰队。亨利四世统治时期，拉罗谢尔曾享有一定程度的自由和繁荣；但到17世纪20年代，路易十三国王加强中央集权，拉罗谢尔在1622年胡格诺派叛乱中与中央政府发生冲突。

en.s: The Second Battle of Newbury was a battle of the English Civil War fought on 27 October 1644, in Speen, adjoining Newbury in Berkshire. The battle was fought close to the site of the First Battle of Newbury, which took place in late September the previous year. The combined armies of Parliament inflicted a tactical defeat on the Royalists, but failed to gain any strategic advantage.

zh.s: 第二次纽伯里战役于1644年10月27日在伯克郡斯彭、纽伯里附近发生，是英国内战中的一场战斗。战场靠近前一年9月底第一次纽伯里战役的旧址。议会军联军在战术上击败保王党军队，但未能取得战略优势。

en.s: The siege of Newcastle (3 February 1644 – 27 October 1644) occurred during the First English Civil War, when a Covenanter army under the command of Lord General Alexander Leslie, 1st Earl of Leven besieged the Royalist garrison under Sir John Marlay, the city's governor. Eventually, the Covenanters took the city of Newcastle upon Tyne by storm, and the Royalist garrison who still held castle keep surrendered on terms.

en.s: Limerick, in western Ireland was the scene of two sieges during the Irish Confederate Wars. The second and largest of these took place during the Cromwellian conquest of Ireland in 1650–51. Limerick was one of the last fortified cities held by an alliance of Irish Confederates and Royalists against the forces of the English Parliament. Its garrison, led by Hugh Dubh O'Neill, surrendered to Henry Ireton after a protracted and bitter siege.

en.t: Franco-Dutch War: French forces surrender the fortress town of Grave to the Dutch army after a three month siege
en.s: The siege of Grave took place from 25 July to 27 October in 1674 during the Franco–Dutch War of 1672 to 1678, when a Dutch army captured the Dutch fortress town of Grave (De Graaf) in what is now North Brabant. Grave had been occupied by the French since the summer of 1672 when an army under Turenne forced the town to surrender.

zh.t: 法荷战争：荷军攻占格拉夫
zh.s: 格拉夫围城战发生于1674年7月25日至10月27日，是1672年至1678年法荷战争的一部分。荷兰军队攻占了如今位于北布拉班特省的荷兰要塞城镇格拉夫（De Graaf）。自1672年夏天起，格拉夫一直被法军占据；当时蒂雷纳子爵率领的军队迫使该城投降。

en.t: J. S. Bach leads the first performance of Ich will den Kreuzstab gerne tragen, BWV 56, one of few works he called a cantata
en.s: Ich will den Kreuzstab gerne tragen (lit. 'I will gladly carry the cross-staff'), BWV 56, is a church cantata composed by Johann Sebastian Bach for the 19th Sunday after Trinity. It was first performed in Leipzig on 27 October 1726. The composition is a solo cantata (German: Solokantate) because, apart from the closing chorale, it requires only a single vocal soloist (in this case a bass).

zh.t: 巴赫指挥《我欣然背负十字架》首演，BWV 56
zh.s: 《我欣然背负十字架》（Ich will den Kreuzstab gerne tragen，直译为“我愿欣然背负十字架”），作品编号BWV 56，是约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫为三位一体后第19个主日创作的一部教会康塔塔。作品于1726年10月27日在莱比锡首次演出。这是一部独唱康塔塔（德语：Solokantate），除结尾众赞歌外只需一名独唱者，此处为男低音。

en.s: The Battle of Krajova was a military engagement between the Austrians stationed in Craiova and the Ottomans who attacked them. The Austrians withdrew but were attacked by the Ottomans, inflicting heavy losses on the retreating Austrians.

zh.s: 克拉约瓦之战是驻扎在克拉约瓦的奥地利军队与进攻他们的奥斯曼军队之间的一场军事交战。奥军撤退时遭奥斯曼军队袭击，损失惨重。

en.s: The Siege of Pondicherry (August – October 1748) was conducted by British forces against a French East India Company garrison under the command of Governor-General Joseph François Dupleix at the Indian port of Pondicherry. The British siege strategy, conducted with inexperience in siege tactics by Admiral Edward Boscawen, was lifted with the arrival of monsoon rains, on 27 October 1748. The siege was the last major action of the First Carnatic War, as the Indian theatre of the War of the Austrian Succession is sometimes known.

zh.s: 英国军队于1748年8月至10月围攻印度港口本地治里，守军是法国东印度公司驻军，由总督约瑟夫·弗朗索瓦·杜普莱克斯指挥。爱德华·博斯科恩海军上将缺乏围城经验，所采用的英军围城策略未能奏效。季风雨于10月27日到来后，英军解除围城。这是第一次卡纳提克战争的最后一场重大战斗；第一次卡纳提克战争有时也指奥地利王位继承战争在印度战场的冲突。

en.s: The Proclamation of Rebellion, officially titled A Proclamation for Suppressing Rebellion and Sedition, was the response of King George III to the news of the Battle of Bunker Hill at the outset of the American Revolutionary War. Issued on 23 August 1775, it declared elements of the American colonies in a state of "open and avowed rebellion".
en.n: King George III expands on his Proclamation of Rebellion in the Thirteen Colonies in his speech from the throne at the opening of Parliament.

zh.s: 《叛乱宣言》的正式名称为《镇压叛乱和煽动叛乱宣言》，是乔治三世国王在美国独立战争初期得知邦克山战役消息后的回应。宣言于1775年8月23日发布，宣布美洲殖民地部分地区处于“公开且公然的叛乱”状态。

en.s: The Battle of Turnhout (27 October 1789) was a battle which took place in the town of Turnhout (today in Belgium) between Habsburg Austria and a Belgian émigré (Patriot) army commanded by Jean-André van der Mersch which had recently invaded from the nearby Dutch Republic. The battle was one of the pivotal moments of the Brabant Revolution and the Patriots' unlikely victory led to the expulsion of Austrian forces to Luxembourg from the Southern Netherlands for nearly a year.

zh.s: 图恩豪特战役于1789年10月27日在今比利时图恩豪特镇发生，交战双方为哈布斯堡奥地利和让-安德烈·范德米尔希指挥的比利时流亡者（爱国者）军队。后者刚从邻近的荷兰共和国入侵当地。战役是布拉班特革命的关键事件之一，爱国者军队意外获胜，迫使奥军撤出南尼德兰并退至卢森堡，近一年后才返回。

en.s: The Battle of Entrames was fought on 27 October 1793 during the French Revolutionary Wars. It pitted Republican forces against Vendée Royalists near Entrames in Mayenne, and it resulted in a Royalist victory.

zh.s: 昂特拉姆战役于1793年10月27日法国大革命战争期间发生。交战双方为共和军和旺代保王党军，战场位于马耶讷省昂特拉姆附近。保王党获胜。

en.s: Pinckney's Treaty, also known as the Treaty of San Lorenzo or the Treaty of Madrid, was signed on October 27, 1795, by the United States and Spain. It defined the border between the United States and Spanish Florida, and guaranteed the United States navigation rights on the Mississippi River. With this agreement, the first phase of the ongoing border dispute between the two nations in this region, commonly called the West Florida Controversy, came to a close.

zh.s: 《平克尼条约》又称《圣洛伦索条约》或《马德里条约》，由美国和西班牙于1795年10月27日签署。条约划定了美国与西属佛罗里达之间的边界，并保障美国在密西西比河上的航行权。协议结束了两国在该地区持续的边界争端第一阶段，这场争端通常称为西佛罗里达争端。

en.s: The Battle of Koljonvirta (Finnish: Koljonvirran taistelu) (Swedish: Virta Bro) i.e. the Battle of the Virta Bridge was fought between Swedish and Russian troops on October 27, 1808. The Swedish force consisted of troops from Savolax and Östergötland. After the main Swedish army had been defeated at the Battle of Oravais the army under Johan August Sandels in Savonia had to retreat in order not to be outflanked by the Russians. Sandels found a good defensive position north of Iisalmi and decided to resist the Russian advance there. Between September 29 and October 27 a cease-fire was in effect.

zh.s: 科尔约恩维尔塔战役（芬兰语：Koljonvirran taistelu；瑞典语：Virta Bro），即“维尔塔桥之战”，于1808年10月27日由瑞典军队与俄军交战。瑞典部队来自萨沃尼亚和东约特兰。瑞典主力在奥拉瓦伊斯战役中战败后，约翰·奥古斯特·桑德尔斯指挥的萨沃尼亚军队为避免被俄军包抄，不得不撤退。桑德尔斯在伊萨尔米以北找到有利防守位置，决定在那里抵抗俄军推进。9月29日至10月27日间，双方停火。

It was the first skirmish of the Army of the North in this theatre. The battle was fought near the town of Santiago de Cotagaita, nowadays in Potosí Department in Bolivia.

en.s: The Battle of Beler (Spanish: Batalla de Beler) was one of the major battles of the Dominican War of Independence and was fought on the 27 October 1845 at the Beler savanna, Monte Cristi Province. A force of Dominican troops, a portion of the Army of the North, led by General Francisco Antonio Salcedo, defeated a force of the Haitian Army led by General Jean-Louis Pierrot, while 3 Dominican schooners led by Admiral Juan Bautista Cambiaso, blockaded the port of Cap-Haïtien to prevent sea reinforcements of the near sited land battle.

zh.s: 贝莱尔战役（西班牙语：Batalla de Beler）是多米尼加独立战争中的一场重要战斗，于1845年10月27日在蒙特克里斯蒂省贝莱尔草原发生。弗朗西斯科·安东尼奥·萨尔塞多将军率领一支多米尼加军队，属于北方军的一部分，击败了让-路易·皮埃罗将军领导的海地军队。胡安·包蒂斯塔·坎比亚索海军上将还率领3艘多米尼加纵帆船封锁海地角港，阻止海上援军支援附近的陆上战斗。

Italian volunteers charged the Austrian fortification, took the town and withdrew, with the loot of three baggage-waggons, eight horses, large quantity of ammunition and the military chest, back to the fort at Marghera.

en.t: Revolutions of 1848 in the Italian states
en.s: The revolutions of 1848 in the Italian states, part of the wider revolutions of 1848 in Europe, were organized revolts in the states of the Italian Peninsula and Sicily, led by intellectuals and agitators who desired a liberal government. As Italian nationalists they sought to eliminate reactionary Austrian control. During this time, Italy was not a unified country, and was divided into many states, which, in Northern Italy, were ruled directly or indirectly by the Austrian Empire.

en.s: The Battle of Brown's Ferry was an engagement of the American Civil War which took place on October 27, 1863 in Hamilton County, Tennessee. During the battle, two Union brigades drove Confederate sharpshooters from the Tennessee River, which allowed supplies to start arriving to the Union army at Chattanooga. Although a minor engagement, the battle proved to have significant results in paving the way for the Union victory at Chattanooga a month later.

en.t: Battle of Fair Oaks & Darbytown Road
en.s: The Battle of Fair Oaks & Darbytown Road (also known as the Second Battle of Fair Oaks) was fought October 27–28, 1864, in Henrico County, Virginia, as part of the Richmond-Petersburg Campaign of the American Civil War. In combination with movements against the Boydton Plank Road at Petersburg, Maj. Gen. Benjamin Butler attacked the Richmond defenses along Darbytown Road with the X Corps. The XVIII Corps marched north to Fair Oaks where it was soundly repulsed by Maj. Gen. Charles W. Field's Confederate division. Confederate forces counterattacked, taking some 600 prisoners. The Richmond defenses remained intact. Of Lt. Gen.

en.s: The Černová massacre (or Černová tragedy, Slovak: Černovská tragédia, Hungarian: Csernovai tragédia or Csernova Affair) was a shooting that happened in Csernova, Kingdom of Hungary (today Černová, part of Ružomberok, Slovakia) on 27 October 1907 in which 15 people were killed and many were wounded after gendarmes fired into a crowd of people gathering for the consecration of the local Catholic church. The shootings sparked protests in European and American press and turned world's attention to the treatment of minorities in the Hungarian part of Austria-Hungary.

zh.s: 切尔诺瓦惨案又称切尔诺瓦悲剧（斯洛伐克语：Černovská tragédia；匈牙利语：Csernovai tragédia或Csernova Affair），于1907年10月27日在匈牙利王国切尔诺瓦（今斯洛伐克鲁容贝罗克的一部分）发生。为当地天主教堂祝圣仪式聚集的人群遭宪兵开枪射击，15人死亡，多人受伤。枪击事件引发欧洲和美国媒体抗议，使国际社会关注奥匈帝国匈牙利部分地区对少数族群的待遇。

en.s: The London Naval Treaty, officially the Treaty for the Limitation and Reduction of Naval Armament, was an agreement between the United Kingdom, Japan, France, Italy, and the United States that was signed on 22 April 1930. en.s: The United Kingdom general election held on Tuesday 27 October 1931 saw a landslide election victory for the National Government which had been formed two months previously after the collapse of the previous Labour government. The bulk of the National Government's support came from the Conservative Party, and the Conservatives won 470 seats. The Labour party suffered its greatest defeat, losing four out of five seats compared with the previous election. The Liberal Party, split into three factions, continued to shrink and the Liberal National faction never reunited. Ivor Bulmer-Thomas said the results "were the most astonishing in the history of the British party system".

zh.s: 英国于1931年10月27日星期二举行大选。两个月前，前工党政府垮台后成立的国民政府在此次选举中大获全胜。国民政府的大部分支持来自保守党，保守党赢得470席。工党遭遇史上最惨重的败选，相比上次选举失去五分之四的席位。自由党分裂成三个派系后继续衰退，自由国家党派系也再未与其他派系合并。伊沃·布尔默-托马斯称，选举结果“是英国政党制度史上最令人惊讶的”。

en.t: Abdication Crisis: Mrs. Wallis Simpson obtains her divorce, which would eventually allow her to marry King Edward VIII of the United Kingdom, thus forcing his abdication from the throne
en.s: In early December 1936, a constitutional crisis in the British Empire arose when King Edward VIII proposed to marry Wallis Simpson, an American socialite who was divorced from her first husband and was in the process of divorcing her second. The marriage was opposed by the governments of the United Kingdom and the Dominions of the British Commonwealth. Religious, legal, political, and moral objections were raised.

zh.s: 1936年12月初，大英帝国爆发宪政危机。爱德华八世国王打算与美国名媛沃利斯·辛普森结婚；她已与第一任丈夫离婚，当时正办理与第二任丈夫的离婚手续。英国政府和英联邦自治领政府都反对这桩婚事，并提出宗教、法律、政治和道德方面的异议。

en.s: The Battle of Wuhan (traditional Chinese: 武漢會戰; simplified Chinese: 武汉会战; Japanese: 武漢作戦 (ぶかんさくせん)), popularly known to the Chinese as the Defense of Wuhan (traditional Chinese: 武漢保衛戰; simplified Chinese: 武汉保卫战), and to the Japanese as the Capture of Wuhan, was the largest, longest, and bloodiest battle of the Second Sino-Japanese War. The Japanese troops had been stranded on the island during the Battle of Milne Bay in late August 1942.

en.s: The Defence of Outpost Snipe in Egypt was part of the Second Battle of El Alamein, part of the Western Desert campaign during the Second World War. On the night of 26/27 October 1942, the 2nd Battalion of the Rifle Brigade (part of the 7th Motor Brigade), with thirteen 6-pounder anti-tank guns and the 239th Battery, 76th (Royal Welch Fusiliers) Anti-Tank Regiment, Royal Artillery, with six more 6-pounders, was ordered to occupy a desert feature known as Snipe, a small depression in the landscape 1.5 mi (2.4 km) south-west of Kidney Ridge that was suitable for an outpost.

en.s: During World War II, Operation Saxifrage was a raid by four small Special Air Service teams who landed on the east coast of Italy on the night of 27 October 1943. In charge of the operation was Major Roy Farran and Lieutenant Grant Hibbert. The SAS were inserted via boat, somewhere between Pescara and Ancona, using the Tronto river and by late evening, had made landfall with the 16 commandos being divided into 4 teams.

en.s: The Slovak National Uprising (Slovak: Slovenské národné povstanie, abbreviated SNP; alternatively also Povstanie roku 1944, English: The Uprising of 1944) was an attempted insurrection organised by the Slovak resistance during the Second World War. It was directed on the one hand against the German invasion of Slovakia by the Wehrmacht, which began on 29 August 1944, and on the other against the Slovak collaborationist regime of the Ludaks under Jozef Tiso.

zh.s: 斯洛伐克民族起义（斯洛伐克语：Slovenské národné povstanie，简称SNP；又称“1944年起义”）是第二次世界大战期间由斯洛伐克抵抗力量组织的一场未遂起义。一方面，起义反对德国国防军于1944年8月29日开始入侵斯洛伐克；另一方面，也反对约瑟夫·蒂索领导的斯洛伐克傀儡政权。
zh.n: 第二次世界大战：德军攻占班斯卡·比斯特里察，斯洛伐克民族起义随之结束。

en.s: The 1948 Peruvian coup d'état took place on October 27, 1948, headed by general Manuel A. Odría in Arequipa, referred to by him as the "Restorative Revolution" (Spanish: Revolución Restauradora), against the government of José Luis Bustamante y Rivero. Odría seized power. The military coup gave way to a period of almost twenty months in which the deposed president was prosecuted, a state of emergency was declared throughout the country, and the national congress was dissolved.

en.s: The 1948 Donora smog, also called the Donora death fog, was an air pollution disaster that occurred in Donora, Pennsylvania, beginning on October 27, 1948, and lasting several days. It was caused by hydrogen fluoride and sulfur dioxide emissions from U.S. Steel's Donora Zinc Works and its American Steel & Wire plant during an atmospheric temperature inversion.

en.s: General elections were held in Zambia on 27 October 1983. At the time, the country was a one-party state, and as such, the United National Independence Party was the sole contestant in the elections. en.s: General elections were held in Tanzania on 27 October 1985. The country was a one-party state at the time, with the Chama Cha Mapinduzi as the sole legal party. For the National Assembly election there were two candidates from the same party in each constituencies, whilst the presidential election was effectively a referendum on CCM's candidate Ali Hassan Mwinyi, who succeeded Julius Nyerere as president. Several changes were made to the elections, including increasing the number of constituencies from 106 to 119, scrapping the 20 regional seats elected by MPs, and the introduction of 15 reserved seats for women.

zh.s: 坦桑尼亚于1985年10月27日举行大选。当时该国实行一党制，革命党是唯一合法政党。国民议会选举中，每个选区有两名同一政党的候选人；总统选举实际上是对革命党候选人阿里·哈桑·姆维尼的全民公投，他接替朱利叶斯·尼雷尔出任总统。选举还进行了多项改革，包括将选区从106个增加到119个，取消由议员选出的20个地区席位，并新增15个女性保留席位。

en.s: The 1990 New Zealand general election was held on 27 October to determine the composition of the 43rd New Zealand parliament. The governing Labour Party was defeated in a landslide, ending its two terms in office. The National Party, led by Jim Bolger, won the largest majority government in New Zealand history. This election was the first time since 1975 that National won the popular vote, even if by taking a plurality but not a majority.

zh.s: 新西兰于1990年10月27日举行大选，选出第43届议会。执政工党遭遇压倒性败选，结束连续两个任期的执政。吉姆·博尔格领导的国家党取得新西兰历史上席位最多的多数政府。这是自1975年以来国家党首次赢得最多普选票，但只取得相对多数，没有超过半数。

en.s: The 1991 Polish parliamentary election was held on 27 October 1991 to elect deputies to both houses of the National Assembly. The 1991 election was notable on several counts. It was the first to be held since the formation of the Third Republic, the first entirely free and competitive election since the fall of communism, the first completely free national election of any sort since 1928, and only the fourth free election in all of Polish history. Due to the collapse of the Solidarity movement's political wing, the 1991 election saw deep political fragmentation, with a multitude of new parties and alliances emerging in its wake.

zh.s: 波兰于1991年10月27日举行议会选举，选出国民议会两院的议员。这次选举有多项历史意义：它是第三共和国成立后的首次选举，是共产主义垮台后首次完全自由、竞争性的选举，也是1928年以来首次完全自由的全国选举，并且是波兰历史上仅有的第四次自由选举。由于团结工会的政治派系瓦解，1991年选举后出现大量新政党和联盟，政治格局高度分散。

en.t: After over a century of being a part of the Russian Empire and then the Soviet Union (including 67 years as a union republic), Turkmenistan declared its independence on 27 October 1991, following the dissolution of the Soviet Union

en.s: The 1992 United Nations Security Council election was held on 27 October 1992 during the Forty-seventh session of the United Nations General Assembly, held at United Nations Headquarters in New York City. en.t: United States Navy radioman Allen R. Schindler, Jr. is murdered by shipmate Terry M. Helvey for being gay, precipitating debate about gays in the military that results in the United States' "Don't ask, don't tell" military policy
en.s: Allen R. Schindler Jr. (December 13, 1969 – October 27, 1992) was an American radioman petty officer third class in the United States Navy who was murdered for being gay. en.s: Widerøe Flight 744, also known as the Namsos Accident (Norwegian: Namsos-ulykken), was a scheduled flight of Widerøes Flyveselskap from Trondheim Airport, Værnes, via Namsos, to Rørvik Airport, Ryumsjøen, Norway. On 27 October 1993, the de Havilland Canada DHC-6 Twin Otter serving the flight underwent a controlled flight into terrain during its approach to Namsos Airport, Høknesøra.

zh.s: 维德勒航空744号班机又称纳姆索斯空难（挪威语：Namsos-ulykken），是维德勒航空公司运营的一班定期航班，航线为挪威特隆赫姆机场经纳姆索斯飞往吕姆舍恩岛吕维克机场。1993年10月27日，执行该航班的加拿大德哈维兰DHC-6“双水獭”飞机在接近纳姆索斯霍克内索拉机场时，受控飞行撞地。

en.s: On October 27, 1997, a global stock market crash was caused by the 1997 economic crisis in Asia, the "Asian contagion", or Tom Yum Goong crisis (Thai: วิกฤตต้มยำกุ้ง). The point loss that the Dow Jones Industrial Average suffered on this day currently ranks as the 18th biggest percentage loss since the Dow's creation in 1896. en.s: The 1999 Armenian parliament shooting, commonly known in Armenia as October 27 (Armenian: Հոկտեմբերի 27, romanized: Hoktemberi k'sanyot), was an attack on the Armenian National Assembly in the capital of Yerevan on 27 October 1999 by a group of five armed men led by Nairi Hunanyan that, among others, killed the two de facto decision-makers in the country's political leadership—Prime Minister Vazgen Sargsyan and Parliament Speaker Karen Demirchyan.

en.s: The 2008 Nunavut General Election was held on October 27, 2008, to return members to the 3rd Legislative Assembly of Nunavut.
